Club: Manga.description:
✒️ You are a member of the U.A. Manga club.

🗓️ It meets after classes on Tuesday, Friday, in the Library's quiet rooms.
🤝 Manga Fukidashi runs it; Present Mic is the advisor.
📈 Grants: Visual Arts +5. Practice counts as training.

Say "I quit the club" to leave it.
Club: Manga.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a member of the U.A. Manga club, run by Manga Fukidashi with Present Mic as advisor; it meets after classes on Tuesday, Friday in the Library's quiet rooms. The lead and members know they are a member (never ask them to sign up again). Going to practice is the player's choice each time; a missed practice is fine, a habit of missing gets one honest word from the lead. Club time is real time: an afternoon at the club is an afternoon not spent elsewhere.
